text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... all right...! Just five more 
sets and I'm done for today...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accompany Kitasan Black in her training. 
That "special regimen" continued for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(If I keep going like Kita-chan does, I'm 
sure this weird, gloomy haze will 
disappear!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how tedious the training gets, 
...or how little my times improve.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I won't panic anymore either! I'll act 
just like a manga protagonist! Focus on 
the training――!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Nooooo way!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Rushing won't create a shortcut. I know 
one day in reality isn't just 1 point on a 
stat screen! I know that, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if my head gets it, my heart isn't 
that simple!
choice_data_list: (Mmh!! That's so true!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop feeling so restless and 
uneasy, I just can't focus on training at 
all~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ponder as I listen to Kiseki's screams. 
If I were to give a name to this uneasy 
feeling, would it clear the air, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking that, I open my mouth... —only 
to inhale and think, 'No, this won't do.'"
choice_data_list: What makes you think that, Kiseki?
Why do you think so, Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh—
choice_data_list: Why do I feel so unsettled...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? T-That's... but, it's just not 
working out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is a creator. Her ability to think 
creatively is her greatest treasure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Trainer supporting her, it's fine 
for her to lean on me. It's fine for me to 
relieve her anxieties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—I must not be someone who easily 
keeps robbing her of her thought process.
choice_data_list:
On the other hand, I wonder why Kitasan 
never seems to worry about it?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the protagonist...?
choice_data_list:
Still, you're a contender for the lead 
role too!
But you're a potential protagonist too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"O-Of course! I'm gonna be a main 
character too!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
S-See, she's a different Umamusume than 
me! So her whole way of thinking is 
different... right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that Kita-chan is confident 
because she's getting results?! Um... 
err..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘A lack of self-affirmation gained from 
experience’... Even to me, that comes to 
mind as one of the reasons behind her 
uneasy feelings."
choice_data_list:
(Still, she herself isn't satisfied with 
that.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She ponders. Searching for an answer 
uniquely her own, beyond anything we could 
imagine."
choice_data_list:
(Right, there's no need for the "habit" of 
waiting for the right answer.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Trust her as a creator and wait. We're 
not just teacher and student.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why I will offer it as many times 
as it takes— a catalyst to inspire your 
thoughts and spark new ideas.
choice_data_list:
Let's think more about the differences 
between us.
Let's reflect more on what sets us apart.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Why the sudden urge to go to the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for doing this 
for me!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It's Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………The difference between me and 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Then, here's wishing for Kita-chan's 
victory in the Arima Kinen— Cheers!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, thank you so much for coming 
even though you're busy. Even for a 
homemade send-off party like this...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No! You're all so busy yourself, yet you 
even made such a huge banner for me...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
It's all for Kita-chan's sake! What's 
wrong with giving our all for our dream?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local D
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Kita-chan! Our whole family is 
rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: —Win this, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you I can answer your feelings! 
With this spark everyone lit for me, I'm 
gonna set off a giant firework!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan really is deeply loved by 
everyone in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And I believe the people of the shopping 
district... have very high hopes for 
Kita-chan's Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: Yeah, seems like it. Anything else?
Yeah, seems like it. Anything else?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What else...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local E
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kita-chan. Looks like your friends 
came to see you too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Duramente-san?! What are you doing all 
the way out here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Your leg injury hasn't fully healed yet... 
right? I kept hearing how tough it's been, 
going back and forth between the academy 
and rehab...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were here. ...You, my 
classmate and my rival.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I am the one who won the Double Crown in 
our Classic Year. I was supposed to be 
called the 'strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yet that crown now rests upon your head. 
Ever since you won the Kikuka Sho— the 
race I was never able to run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“...... I still can't say that I've become 
stronger than you.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No, they're strong.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Prove that you are strong. For the day 
when I defeat you next time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the Arima Kinen where I won't be 
running, you win it! Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right. I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: With you, and with everyone—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —For the sake of these memories, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. My situation is completely 
different from Kita-chan's."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because something... something this heavy 
is too much for me to—
choice_data_list: "Like this"? What kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the expectations of everyone in the 
shopping district, and the feelings 
entrusted to me by my rivals. And on top 
of that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —For the sake of these memories, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What could that ring be?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's got to be important, too... A key 
item...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, what is it!? What was it 
again--!?"
choice_data_list: Where are you off to!?
Where are you heading!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the shopping district and 
wandering around all over, Kiseki finally 
came to a halt— in front of a massive 
outdoor screen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"In this upcoming Arima Kinen, I fully 
intend to claim victory."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Because in that Arima Kinen, the showdown 
with her 'childhood friend' Kitasan Black 
will finally become reality."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Yes! It feels like a dream come true♪"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that's it. On Dia-chan's pinky 
finger is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —The same pinky ring as Kita-chan's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...A long time ago, I promised Kita-chan 
that we'd run in a GⅠ together."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "I can finally fulfill that promise."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pull up right behind her, overtake 
her, and become a 'Legendary Umamusume'!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "'...A "renowned Umamusume", is it?'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I want to become someone who can 
make the Umamusume world shine even 
brighter, supporting it from within."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The Satono family has always stood 
alongside the racing world, wishing for 
its growth and striving to contribute to 
its development."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"‘That is why becoming a celebrated horse 
girl is the very reason I was born a 
Satono. ...Or so I believe.’"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
'It's a culture unique to the Uma Musume 
world. The production of famous Uma Musume 
raises expectations for the next 
generation, ――and becomes a symbol of 
"hope".'

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Just hearing your story, I can feel the 
immense weight of your resolve."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is not heavy at all. For my 
mission is what carries me forward."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you I can answer your feelings! 
With this spark everyone lit for me, I'm 
gonna set off a giant firework!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――! Backbone...?!
choice_data_list: Backbone...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's just like Kita-chan earlier! 
Dia-chan is also carrying the exact same 
heavy burden!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They both have one! There is a grand 
background behind them...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"—And here we have an example of the 
training regimen that Satono Diamond 
undertook this time, but..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Logging meals, checking my running form 
on video, a 5km run, and six sets of 100 
jump rope reps."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"That's somewhat surprising. Especially 
since the Satono Group has such advanced 
scientific divisions, like the Umulator."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"It was very tedious, or rather... It was 
full of routines where just sticking with 
it was a struggle..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: “—It is not painful in the slightest.”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —For the sake of these memories, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: “...The motivation pushing me forward is—”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"‘Because it pulls my heart forward— 
leaving me no time to even glance aside.’"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so this is what it was.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is the reason I can face forward with 
a smile.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(—Just before the Arima Kinen. Kita-chan 
and Dia-chan were making their final 
preparations.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (—Background)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...A "reason" to look forward with a 
smile.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how mundane, flat, and 
repetitive each day becomes to the point 
of boredom.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I want to 'live up to them'.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For my injured rival's sake. For everyone 
cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...For the sake of my clan. ...For the 
very purpose of my birth."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...All for the sake of the promise I made 
with my childhood friend, which I've 
treasured all this time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaahhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't have anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm rushing, getting frustrated, and on 
top of that, I can't even focus on 
training! Right now, I'm just—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—What you're carrying on your shoulders is 
paper-thin!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's totally natural to feel rushed or 
frustrated. After all, compared to those 
girls, it's not heavy at all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hahaha! I somehow—feel completely 
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. At Nakayama 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I want to add even more depth to 
my backstory.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like Kita-chan and Dia-chan! So 
hyper-focused that there's no time to feel 
gloomy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll make tons of things precious to me! 
And make my background richer and richer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her speak so brightly about the 
optimal answer she had reached for 
herself, I couldn't help but smile.
choice_data_list:
...Your flashes of inspiration are always 
fascinating.

...Your flashes of inspiration are always 
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But for me, my real journey starts 
now! ...I've still got a long way to go!
choice_data_list:
And someday, you're gonna become the main 
character!

And someday, you're gonna become the main 
character, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She possesses that irreplaceable backdrop 
called a dream. From here on, expectations 
and promises will pile up endlessly—and 
she will likely carry many backgrounds 
upon her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, it's Kiseki! Kiseki, do your best 
next year too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? —...I-I'll do my best! I'll give it 
everything I've got, I promise!!
choice_data_list:
You have so many more backdrops to add to 
your story.

You'll have plenty more memories to fill 
your background from now on.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From here on, first of all, I want to 
stack up graded race victories.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward like that. Expanding your 
horizons.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And it's about to begin! Which Umamusume 
will become this year's dream?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black enters the gate. Satono 
Diamond follows suit! And now—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen, is 
underway!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Gooooo, Kitasan Black—!" "Miladyyyy! Lady 
Diaaaaa!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's started. The match between 
those two—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen—belonging to those two!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
“Kitasan! You're our strongest champion!” 
“Win it, Dia! Chase her down! Pass her, 
pass herーー!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't back down...! Both of you...! 
Win...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is in the lead! But Satono 
Diamond is closing in fast!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gooooooooooooooo for it!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is it Kitasan Black, or Satono Diamond?! 
They cross the finish line neck and 
neeeeeeck!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! Ahahahaha! I'm gonna become just 
like that toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My work is only just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki shouted at the top of her lungs. 
From the next day on, the sighs she let 
out during training had completely 
vanished before anyone noticed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—First is securing a graded stakes win. 
Building her background starts from 
there.”
